$comment: Direct code dependencies. Governed by resource-policy.json and MASTER_PROJECT.md section 20.2. Phase 11 correction: ajv/ajv-formats moved here from verifiedButNotInstalled - they were installed and shipped as of Phase 2 (packages/schemas), this manifest just never caught up. See docs/resources/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md's Phase 11 correction note. Phase 12 correction: playwright-core (packages/qa) and @types/node (root) were real, declared, direct dependencies that this manifest had never recorded - playwright-core's provenance was documented in docs/architecture/DEPENDENCY_BASELINE.md since Phase 8, but resource-policy.json names this file as the machine-readable record and it was incomplete. Both added; packages/cli/test/codeResourceManifest.test.ts now derives the required set mechanically from every workspace package.json, so this class of omission cannot recur silently.

dependencies.name: phaser
dependencies.purpose: Game runtime: scene manager, arcade physics, WebGL/Canvas renderer, texture cache.
dependencies.removalPath: Replacing the runtime engine is an architecture change (ADR-0001), not a dependency swap.

dependencies.name: ajv
dependencies.purpose: JSON Schema validation. @sw2d/schemas is a `dependencies` entry of every generated game and validates content/pack-config documents at runtime (validateDocumentOrThrow, packConfigValidator), not only at CLI/build time.
dependencies.removalPath: Only replaceable together with @sw2d/schemas' validator implementation; not a drop-in swap.

dependencies.name: ajv-formats
dependencies.purpose: Format validators (date-time etc.) for ajv. Shipped for the same reason as ajv above.
dependencies.removalPath: Companion to ajv; removal path is the same.

dependencies.name: typescript
dependencies.purpose: Static checking across all packages. Runs with --noEmit; Vite/esbuild transpiles.
dependencies.removalPath: Downgrade to 6.0.3 is a drop-in. Not on the runtime path.

dependencies.name: vite
dependencies.purpose: Development server and production bundler for the browser target.
dependencies.notes: Optional analytics is not configured and nothing opts into it.
dependencies.removalPath: Replaceable by another bundler; only starter/vite.config.ts and the build scripts depend on it.

dependencies.name: vitest
dependencies.purpose: Unit test runner. Shares Vite's transform, so there is no second build configuration.
dependencies.removalPath: Test-only. Replaceable by any TypeScript-aware runner.

dependencies.name: playwright-core
dependencies.purpose: Drives a system-installed Chrome/Chromium for every real-browser QA command (@sw2d/qa's harness: qa:smoke, qa:proof, qa:responsive, release:verify, qa:matrix). Dev-only; no generated game depends on it.
dependencies.notes: playwright-core is used deliberately instead of the full playwright package: it has no post-install browser download, so installing this repository never fetches a browser binary. It connects to a system Chrome found by packages/qa/src/browserPath.ts (overridable via PLAYWRIGHT_CHROME_PATH).
dependencies.removalPath: Test-only. Replaceable by any Chrome DevTools Protocol driver; only packages/qa/src/harness.ts and browserPath.ts depend on it.

dependencies.name: @types/node
dependencies.purpose: Node standard-library type declarations for the CLI, QA harness and tools/scripts. Types only - erased at build time.
dependencies.removalPath: Declarations only; removable the moment no Node API is referenced from TypeScript, which is not the case today.
